{{ $current := . }}
{{/* The drawer is fixed to the viewport, so it has to START where the sticky chrome ends. `inset-y-0` + `pt-28` instead pinned it to y=0 and pushed the list down with padding, which painted the drawer's own opaque panel over the top strip — a blank white block beside the strip's links — and left dead space that was only ever the right size at one scroll position. top-[149px] (drawer) and lg:top-[149px] (desktop) are the strip + header height as a no-JS fallback; initSidebar measures #site-chrome and sets the exact inline top (and, on desktop, height). Desktop: the page wrapper has py-10, so the sticky box would otherwise start 40px below the chrome at the top of the page — its scroll clipping edge and its right-hand divider hung below the header until the page had scrolled. lg:-mt-10 pulls the box up to the chrome; lg:pt-[34px] puts the first link's text on the same line as the page's breadcrumb text. */}}
{{/* One nav for the desktop sidebar and the phone drawer: the active section, walking the native page tree. The drawer used to carry a second nav with every top-level section expandable, and each section's whole tree inside it. In production every version is a section, so each page shipped all of them, hidden. Other versions are one click away in the version menu. */}} {{ $root := .FirstSection }} {{ if .IsHome }} {{ $root = .Site.GetPage (printf "/%s" site.Params.homeSlug) }} {{ end }} {{/* The product's name over its menu, as on the other GoodData docs (Python SDK), linking to the docs home: there is no separate "Home" row. params.productName, or the root page's own title without it. Not a heading element: the page's own h1 starts the outline. */}} {{ with $root }} {{ $isRootActive := or (eq $current.RelPermalink .RelPermalink) $current.IsHome }} {{ site.Params.productName | default .LinkTitle }} {{ end }}
{{ with $root }} {{ partial "sidebar-tree.html" (dict "pages" .Pages "current" $current) }} {{ end }} {{/* Off-site sections after the page tree, e.g. Release notes on GitHub: params.sidebarLinks, a list of {name, url}. A header row like a section's, with an arrow for "leaves the docs". Config rather than a stub content page, which would land in the sitemap, llms.txt and search. */}} {{ range site.Params.sidebarLinks }}
{{ .name }} (opens in a new tab)
{{ end }}
